title: Race-R Pro GP Tech TC-2

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Serving closed-circuit and supersport riders, the Shark Race-R Pro GP Tech TC-2 is designed to deliver razor-sharp aerodynamics in a chin-on-tank tuck. Featuring a Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) architecture at a featherweight 1295g, it combines progressive kinetic energy dissipation across DOT, ECE 22.05 certifications with an acoustically tuned ~92 dB aero profile. A plush, washable 3D comfort liner cradles Intermediate Oval head shapes with zero temple pinch for glasses wearers, locked in securely with track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: MotoGP-grade race helmet with carbon-aramid shell and double-D ring.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Designed for aggressive track fit; requires precise sizing due to minimal padding.

technical_analysis: Features Carbon-On-Skin composite structure with CFD aerodynamic wind-tunnel tuned rear spoiler profile paired with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation. The interior utilizes Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Shark Race-R Pro GP Tech TC-2: combining France 🇫🇷 craftsmanship with Autoseal visor mechanism pressing the shield onto the helmet gasket for rain and sound insulation and Bamboo fiber eco-friendly lining with EasyFit glasses grooves for riders wearing spectacles. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.

introduction: Positioned in Shark's Track / Race lineup, the Race-R Pro GP Tech TC-2 brings French engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Shark Race-R Pro GP Tech TC-2 represents Shark's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~92 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Track / Race helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Shark Race-R Pro GP Tech TC-2 delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
